title: [Feature Request] please add Lyumjev to multiple insulin types
body:
More and more people are using Lyumjev that's why I like to have it in xDrip below is the acting profile of Lyumjev peak is about 55 minutes 


![Screenshot_20201220-140451_AndroidAPS.png](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/45721291/102714142-fec4bd00-42cc-11eb-88ee-7227dfc5fba2.png)

comments.body: We still need the exact function/values to calculate the maximum and duration of action.

+1
I've switched from Fiasp to Lyumjev.  Where can I find the info @tolot27 you need to take next steps?

> We still need the exact function/values to calculate the maximum and duration of action.

I did not find sufficient data to determine a fitting function. [Figure 4 from Linnebjerg et al., 2020](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s40262-020-00903-0/figures/4) shows a Local Polynomial Regression (LOESS) fitting of the mean glucose infusion rate over time for URLi and Humalog but is based on only 41 younger adults (aged
18–45 years) and 39 elderly (aged ≥65 years) patients with T1DM.

@FreDiabetics Where did you get the curve from?

> @FreDiabetics Where did you get the curve from?


It's from AndroidAPS
https://medlibrary.org/lib/images-rx/lyumjev/lyumjev-uspi-f1-v1.jpg shows a similar picture with different insulin units.

> > @FreDiabetics Where did you get the curve from?
> 
> It's from AndroidAPS

Got it from https://github.com/openaps/AndroidAPSdocs/blob/master/docs/EN/Configuration/Config-Builder.md#insulin. And you configured your own DIA, right?

I am closing this issue because we have consolidated all insulin requests: #1898
You can continue the conversation here in this issue about this particular request.

Please don't post in the consolidated table issue. Please either use this issue or [Discussions](https://github.com/Navid200/xDrip/discussions) for any conversations.

> Does anyone has access to https://www.healthgrades.com/drugs/lyumjev/pharmacology?

Parameter for Insulin Effect | LYUMJEV7 units | LYUMJEV15 units | LYUMJEV30 units

Time to first measurable effect | ~17 minutes | ~17 minutes | ~15 minutes
Time to peak effect | ~120 minutes | ~138 minutes | ~174 minutes
Time for the effect to return to baseline | ~4.6 hours | ~6.2 hours | ~7.3 hours

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4199669/178121503-e3a31745-d640-4978-ade0-3e40edda8f40.png)

Type 1 Diabetes – Adults
Mealtime LYUMJEV + basal insulin | Mealtime HUMALOG + basal insulin | Postmeal LYUMJEV + basal insulin

Number of randomized subjects (N) | 451 | 442 | 329
HbA 1c (%) (mean) a,b
Baseline | 7.3 | 7.3 | 7.4
Adjusted mean change from baseline | -0.12 | -0.04 | 0.1
Estimated treatment difference versus HUMALOG [95% CI] | -0.08 [-0.16, 0.00]c |   | 0.14 [0.05, 0.22]

Type 2 Diabetes – Adults
Mealtime LYUMJEV + basal insulin | Mealtime HUMALOG + basal insulin
Number of randomized subjects (N) | 336 | 337
HbA 1c (%) a,b
Baseline mean | 7.3 | 7.3
Adjusted mean change from baseline | -0.36 | -0.38
Estimated treatment difference versus HUMALOG [95% CI]c | 0.03 [-0.08, 0.13]

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4199669/178121621-cc47eded-fc1a-4a5d-a73d-d09d3fd83222.png)

Following a standardized test meal, treatment with Lyumjev demonstrated statistically significantly 
lower 1 hour and 2 hour postprandial glucose. The treatment difference was - 1.34 mmol/L [95 % CI: -
2.00, - 0.68] and -1.54 mmol/L [95 % CI:- 2.37, - 0.72], respectively compared to Humalog
